ns2:section.sectionText: STUDENTS INTERESTED IN NEWS-EDITORIAL JOURNALISM SHOULD CONSIDER THIS SECTION. Students who have completed JOUR 400 should not register for JOUR 210. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Note: Pre-req for this course will be enforced.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Journalism or News-Editorial or Agricultural Communications major(s).
